context: Daichi and Mei watch their kids practicing for a school singing event.
purpose: Parents fondly observing a child rehearsal.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Soft, warm opening. Quiet pride in her voice—the kind of admiration that doesn't announce itself. Gentle pace. Trailing warmth at the end, like she's speaking more to herself than to him.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Kansai lilt warm and unhurried. Genuine appreciation—not performing, just noticing. Lets the word 'lovely' settle a moment before moving on. Soft, paternal warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Such perfect harmony in their voices.
lines.style: Quiet, attentive observation. Slight tilt of the head in the tone—she's really listening. Warm fondness, not gushing. Thoughtful pause before 'perfect,' like she's choosing the word carefully.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 練習、頑張ってきたんやな。
lines.en: They must've put in real work for this.
lines.style: Kansai warmth with quiet recognition beneath. Not rhetorical—genuinely speaking to what he sees in their effort. Slow, deliberate. Soft pride in knowing they tried.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: I can't wait for the performance.
lines.style: Tender, genuine anticipation. Soft opening on 'can't.' Builds gently with hope. Trails off at the end like she's already imagining it—present, not distant.
